2. For the sake of convenience, the parties are described as

3. Briefly stated, the facts are:
The Complainant booked
 flight tickets online through
 Opposite Party No.1 on 21,03.2015 to travel from Hyderabad to
 Visakhapatnam and the journey was slated for 07.05.2015. The

 He booked for himself and his family members. It is his cantention

 No.3 from Hyderabad to Visakhapatnam as there was a transition
 to the new schedule. He was also informed that they
 summer

 and if they did not show preference, the ticket would be cancelled
 and the entire amounts would be refunded. But the Opposite Party

 No.3 also cancelled their return tickets without any intimation and
 they were advised to purchase fresh tickets at the prevailing rates.
 This action of the Opposite Party No.3 in unilaterally cancelling the
 ticket amounts to deficiency in service and hence the present

 complaint.
The Opposite Party No.1 and 2 filed their written version.

behalf.

Appellants/Complainants filed this appeal contending that the
Commission below had failed to

.The Forum erred in
 partly allowing the complaint and

 agony and trauma undergone by the
 Appellants/Complainants.
The Forum below

 Respondents/Opposite Party

9 The Appellants/Complainants booked air tickets through
 Make My Trip i.e., Respondents/Opposite Party No. 1 & 2 for

 Visakhapatnam and also for the return journey on 09.05.2015. On
 23.04.2015, he received a message from the Respondent/Opposite
 Party on his mobile, that there is re-schedule of the flight operated

 Visakhapatnam: On receipt of the information of flight change, he

 the re-schedule flight rates were changed and his ticket would be
 cancelled and entire refund would be arranged if he did not want
.to pay at the prevailing price. He was forced either to travel in re-
scheduled flight by purchasing the ticket afresh or alternatively to
 accept the total refund on cancelling the flight tickets.
10. The Appellants/Complainants chose to cancel the flight from
 Hyderabad to Visakhapatnam and opted to get refund of the ticket

Respondents/Opposite Party No.3 & 4 to purchase tickets at the
 current rate. Left with no option, he purchased tickets for himself
 and his family members and claims that he got refund of only
 Rs.2,430/- out of the total sum of Rs.19,930/-. A sum of
 Rs.17,500/- was deducted towards cancellation of flight.

15. The tickets booked for the to and fro

same ID and cancelling one sector meant the return

trade practice the part of the

16. In the result, the appeal is dismissed and the order of the
